pages.text: $(bold)Rake$()$(br)Right-click the ground to till a $(bold)3x3$() patch of farmland in one sweep - it reaches a block up or down and clears surface weeds, costing only $(bold)1$() durability per pass.
$(bold)Handcart$()$(br)Place it, then right-click the cart to tow it along behind you; sneak to let go.$(br2)Hold a $(bold)chest$() and right-click the cart to expand its capacity.
